intro: The smallest set of front-end changes inside the module that removes the biggest causes of slowness: idle animation, scroll cost, the slow open and crash paths. No backend work, no shared-package changes, no new dependencies, no feature switches, and no change to what users see apart from faster screens and fixed bugs.

items.title: Carousels rotate only while visible
items.why: Both carousels auto-play every 4–5 s forever, even when scrolled off screen, inside a collapsed section, under another page, or with the app in the background. This is the most likely cause of the 13.3 fps idle redraw and the ~54 % idle CPU.
items.change: Add three things to each carousel's State: a VisibilityDetector around the existing CarouselSlider (already used in this module by research_ideas_accordion.dart and last_visited_stocks_accordion.dart), an app-lifecycle observer, and a route-is-current check. Pass the combined result as autoPlay instead of true.
items.risk_why: Two widgets only. When the carousel is on screen it rotates exactly as today, with the same interval, cards, taps and dots.
test: Carousel rotates when on screen, stops when scrolled away, resumes when scrolled back
Stops when the section is collapsed, another page is pushed, or the app goes to background
Tap on a card and swipe still work
Idle frame counter on an idle Overview after market close
items.effect: Idle redraw ≈ 0 fps when the carousels are not on screen; a large drop in idle CPU and battery.

items.title: Stop walking the widget tree on every scroll
items.why: On every scroll event the sticky chips run a full depth-first walk of the page's element tree, up to 16 times (once per section), to find where each section is. Fundamentals and Technicals also create a new GlobalKey on every build, which remounts their sections.
items.change: First make the Fundamentals/Technicals section keys stable (same putIfAbsent map Overview already uses). Then look up each section by the key it already registers with WidgetVisibilityTracker, cache the offsets until an accordion opens/closes or data changes, and check at most every 100 ms plus once on scroll end.
items.risk_why: Touches chip selection while scrolling. The offset formula (top + offset − 100) and the 50 px hysteresis stay the same, so the same chip is selected; the old walk stays as a fallback when a key is missing.
test: Chip highlight follows the scroll on Overview, Fundamentals and Technicals
Tapping a chip scrolls to the right section
Expand/collapse a section, then scroll: chip still correct
Scroll fps on Overview
items.effect: The largest per-scroll UI-thread cost removed; expected to be the biggest single scroll improvement.

items.title: Rebuild only the section that changed
items.why: Any accordion tap rebuilds all 16 Overview sections (or all 5 in Fundamentals/Technicals), and the Overview section list is re-created as ~16 new objects on every call, which also re-opens sections the user collapsed.
items.change: Add the section and index to the three buildWhen checks, and turn the _sections getter into a list built once (plus a type-to-section map).
items.risk_why: The builder body is unchanged; non-matching sections render the same thing because their inputs did not change. Collapsed sections now stay collapsed, which fixes a bug.
test: Expand/collapse every section on all three tabs
Collapse a section, wait for background data: it stays collapsed
Switch stock/segment: default expansion as today
items.effect: An accordion tap rebuilds 1 section instead of 16; fewer long frames while data arrives.

items.title: Painters repaint only on real change
items.change: Replace shouldRepaint => true (and the closure/identity comparison in the financial chart) with field comparisons using listEquals; restart the bar animation only when the values changed.
items.risk_why: Painted output for a given input is unchanged; theme changes still repaint.
test: 15-min build-up, moving-average gauge and financial bar chart look and animate as today on first show
Charts don't replay their animation on unrelated taps
items.effect: No repaint of unchanged charts on every frame or tick; the financial chart stops replaying its 300 ms animation.

items.title: Remove debug logging from hot paths
items.change: Delete the debugPrint calls inside paint() and build(), and the print / per-item loops on the Overview load path. debugPrint still prints in release builds.
test: Smoke test of Overview, Fundamentals, 15-min build-up
items.effect: No string building and log I/O during paint, build and every Overview load.

items.title: Faster open: no duplicate getQuote, no artificial waits
items.why: Every open calls getQuote twice (updateSelectedScripId fetches it again), then sleeps 100 ms. Every asset switch waits 300 ms and every tab switch 200 ms on a debounce timer.
items.change: Keep the first getQuote result and reuse it once when updateSelectedScripId asks for the same scrip. Delete the two 100 ms sleeps. Replace the Timers with a generation counter, so only the latest tap emits (same result as the debounce, without the wait).
items.risk_why: Changes timing in the cubit's open and switch flow. Same endpoints, same data and same final state; rapid taps still end on the last tap.
test: Open cash, ETF, index, futures and options quotes
Exchange toggle NSE/BSE
Tap tabs and segments rapidly: ends on the last one with its data
Back during loading: no errors
items.effect: One round trip less on every open (~100–250 ms), 100 ms less per open, 300 ms less per asset switch, 200 ms less per tab switch.

items.title: Drop wasted and duplicate Overview calls
items.change: Don't request the 'Market Updates' section (its response is thrown away), call loadPeerComparison only if SimilarStocks failed in the section loop, and reuse the in-flight FlashNews request instead of starting a second one.
items.risk_why: The same data reaches the page from the same endpoints; a failed first call still allows the second as a retry.
test: Overview shows Market updates / flash news, Peer comparison and all other sections as today
Network log: 3 fewer requests per cash open
items.effect: About 18 → 15 requests per cash open (14 with item 6), less data per open.

items.title: Show the last price on the first frame
items.change: Pass the cached last tick (BroadCastHelper.getBroadcastResponse(symbol)) as initialData to the price StreamBuilders in the stock info card and the app bar.
items.risk_why: Same value the stream delivers a moment later; no subscription change.
test: Open a quote: price appears without a 0.00 flash
Price keeps updating during market hours

items.title: Subscribe live prices once, not on every build
items.why: Five widgets call startQuoteStreaming from build() or didUpdateWidget, and several create a new tick stream inside build(). Because each subscribe call replaces the whole symbol set, every rebuild re-sends subscribe packets and the widgets keep overriding each other.
items.change: Move startQuoteStreaming to initState and call it again in didUpdateWidget only when the symbols actually changed (setEquals). Create each onTickReceived stream once in initState instead of inside build().
items.risk_why: Each widget still subscribes the same symbols as today, just once. Resume and visibility paths are untouched; each file can be changed and reverted on its own.
test: Prices update live in Key statistics, CAS, Analyst rating, Research ideas, Peers, header and depth (market hours)
Switch NSE/BSE and segments: prices follow
App background → foreground: prices resume
items.effect: Subscribe packets on an idle page drop from one per rebuild to about zero; less idle network and CPU.

items.title: Load Fundamentals sections in parallel
items.why: Fundamentals fetches its sections one after another and emits after each group.
items.change: Use Future.wait over the foreground sections with one emit, and the same for the background group. Keep one request per section so one failure doesn't fail the others.
items.risk_why: Same requests, same merge, same failure tracking; only concurrency and emit count change. One test expectation is updated.
test: Fundamentals tab: every section shows as today
One section failing (offline mid-load): others still show, Retry works
items.effect: Cold Fundamentals load from ~5 serial requests to 2 parallel rounds.

items.title: Close crash and stuck-loader paths
items.why: The cubit can keep a disposed TabController (swipe then throws); emits after the page closes throw; four places index lists without checking (indexWhere −1, .first on empty, split()[1]) and can leave a tab stuck on a shimmer.
items.change: Keep the cubit's TabController reference in sync and clear it on dispose; override emit with an isClosed check; guard the four throw sites.
items.risk_why: For valid data the same index, expiry and label are produced; only error paths change.
test: Swipe between tabs after switching segment
Leave the page while it loads
Options: switch expiry and call/put after an exchange switch
Futures with no expiries
items.effect: Five crash / non-fatal paths closed; no options or futures tab stuck on a loader.

achieve.after: ≈ 0 fps when the carousels are off screen
large drop (carousels stopped, no repeated subscribe calls)
lower (subscribe packets no longer re-sent on every rebuild)

notice: The page stops working and draining battery when left open. This is the biggest win (items 1 and 9).
Scrolling is clearly smoother on Overview, Fundamentals and Technicals (items 2–5).
Opening a quote and switching tabs or segments is noticeably faster, and the price shows straight away (items 6, 7, 8 and 10).
Fewer odd states: no frozen options or futures tab, no crash when swiping after a segment switch, and collapsed sections no longer re-open on their own (items 3 and 11).
one_line: About 4 days with two developers removes the idle waste and most of the scroll jank, and makes opening and tab switching noticeably faster. It roughly halves the gap to the full-plan targets, mostly on smoothness and battery.

rows.work: Carousels rotate only while visible; remove debug logging. PR 1.
Stable section keys, then the key-based offset lookup in the sticky chips. PR 2.
Rebuild only the changed section; painter shouldRepaint. PR 3.
Reuse the first getQuote, remove the sleeps and debounce timers, initial price value. PR 4.
Drop the wasted/duplicate Overview calls; Fundamentals in parallel. PR 5.
Subscribe once in initState / didUpdateWidget; streams created once. PR 6.
TabController, emit-after-close and the four throw-site guards. PR 7.
Run each PR's checks as it lands, then the full quote-page smoke test and a re-measure on the same device.

schedule_intro: Two FE developers, about 4 days, 7 small pull requests, each releasable and revertible on its own. With one developer the same order takes about 1.5 weeks.
